[[Category:Legal entity]]
A '''legal entity''' is an individual or an [[organisation]] by [[law]]

* considered as distinct;
* entitled to rights and subjected to obligations.

<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

== Representation ==

In general, legal entities can represent '''themselves''' in front of a court of law.

Some legal entities however, must be represented by a [[legal representative]].

* '''Person considered with reduced capacity'''
** [[Minor]]
** [[Adults judged of mental incapacity]]
* '''Organisation (abstract non-life entity)'''
